github.manifestDescription: Create a GitHub App to let users connect their repositories. The app will be automatically configured with the right permissions.

gitlab.step1: Go to GitLab → Preferences → Applications → New application
gitlab.step2: Set the Redirect URI to: {url}/api/git/oauth/callback and select the scopes: api, read_api, read_repository
gitlab.step3: Copy the Application ID and Secret

gitea.step1: In Gitea, go to Settings → Applications → Manage OAuth2 Applications → Create a new OAuth2 application
gitea.step3: Copy the Client ID and Client Secret

bitbucket.step1: In Bitbucket, go to Workspace settings → OAuth consumers → Add consumer
bitbucket.step3: Tick the permissions: Account (Read), Repositories (Read, Write, Admin), Webhooks (Read and write), Pull requests (Read)
bitbucket.step4: Copy the Key and Secret of the created consumer

azureRepos.step1: In the Azure portal, go to Microsoft Entra ID → App registrations → New registration
azureRepos.step2: Set the Redirect URI (type Web) to: {url}/api/git/oauth/callback
azureRepos.step3: Under API permissions, add Azure DevOps → user_impersonation, then grant admin consent
azureRepos.step4: Under Certificates & secrets, create a client secret and copy its value
azureRepos.tenantIdDescription: Required for single-tenant app registrations. Leave empty for multi-tenant apps.

bucketStorage.title: Bucket Storage
bucketStorage.description: Add AWS S3 or any S3-compatible storage to enable backups
bucketStorage.tooltip: Used to store encrypted database and volume backups in Amazon S3 or any S3-compatible provider (MinIO, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, DigitalOcean Spaces…). Connect an account with S3 write permissions.
bucketStorage.hintAws: Use your AWS IAM access keys. Set the region to your bucket's region.
bucketStorage.hintB2: Create an S3-compatible application key. Endpoint: https://s3.REGION.backblazeb2.com
bucketStorage.hintSpaces: Create a Spaces access key. Endpoint: https://REGION.digitaloceanspaces.com
bucketStorage.hintMinio: Use your MinIO access keys and your MinIO server URL as the endpoint.
bucketStorage.hintCustom: Any S3-compatible storage. Enter the provider's S3 endpoint URL.
bucketStorage.addDescription: Enter your credentials. The account must have write permissions. Leave the endpoint empty for AWS S3.
bucketStorage.deleteConfirmDescription: Are you sure you want to remove "{name}"? This action cannot be undone.
